title: Benny and the Apple

visualBible.anchorDescription: Benny is a small brown bunny with long soft ears and a shy smile. Apple is a round bright-red fruit with tiny leaf, rosy cheeks, and a friendly smile. Both keep rounded silhouettes and visible wax-crayon texture.

scenes.chinese: “晚安，本尼。”快乐的苹果轻声说。
